title: LureScope: A Deployable Fraud-Lure Scoring API with a Live Adversarial-Evasion Demo
description:
LureScope is the serving companion to LureBench. It wraps a fraud-lure detector behind a small HTTP API and a browser demo so a single message can be scored, attacked, and then re-scored after an input-normalization defense, making the gap between clean-data accuracy and deployment accuracy visible interactively.

It reuses LureBench's detectors and attacks directly, so the served model and the benchmarked model cannot drift. The bundled demo also ships as a zero-backend static build that runs both baseline detectors, all four character attacks, and the normalization defense entirely in the browser, with the JavaScript port verified against the Python implementation.

The repository additionally publishes two corpus-level robustness scorecards: detector-by-attack evasion rates before and after the defense, and a cross-model comparison of LLM-as-classifier judges.
